title: Larger Immersive Aircrafts: Airship & Cargo Airship
description: A resource pack which enlarges the balloon size for the Airship & Cargo Airship from the mod Immersive Aircraft
body:
### Ever thought the Airship from Immersive Aircraft wasn't big enough?
### Ever thought I need this balloon to bigger to cast a larger shadow in the sky?

# Now you can!
With the new **Larger Immersive Aircraft** both the Airship & Cargo Airship have had their size increased to give the balloon a larger and more 'balloony' feel (yes I just coined the term, trademark pending).

Both craft support their normal functionality with banner placement also adjusted to fit it's new size. Some weapons may be slightly askew, but mostly fit fine, as I didn't want to change the textures for the pack to make it fit.

All credit to the original mod [Immersive Aircraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft)
